title: Oven-Roasted English Potato Welsh Rarebit
description: A single-serving, velvety vegan Welsh rarebit made with roasted Jersey Royal potatoes and a tangy pickle sauce, served on a hot stone plate for a smoky finish.

ingredients.name: Jersey Royal potato
ingredients.notes: peeled and sliced into 1cm thick rounds

instructions: Preheat oven to 200C and place a baking stone or hot stone plate inside to heat.
Toss potato rounds in olive oil, salt, pepper, and smoked paprika until coated, then arrange in a single layer on a sheet pan.
Roast potatoes for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
While potatoes roast, combine vegan cheese, nutritional yeast, oat milk, minced garlic, and a pinch of pepper in a blender until smooth.
Transfer the sauce to a small saucepan and simmer over low heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove the hot stone plate from the oven, place the roasted potatoes on it, and spoon the cheese sauce over the top.
Sprinkle the chopped vegan pickle relish evenly over the cheese layer.
Return the stone plate to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, allowing the sauce to set.
Remove from oven, let rest 2 minutes, then serve immediately while the plate is still hot.
